def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (43 rows, 42 unique ids)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    # Fix species typo variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Strip extra spaces in island
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Normalize sex casing (leave missing as NaN)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(object)
    mask_sex = df['sex'].notna()
    df.loc[mask_sex, 'sex'] = df.loc[mask_sex, 'sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass: 4850000 is 4850 g recorded in mg -> divide by 1000
    bm = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    bad = bm > 6500
    bm[bad] = bm[bad] / 1000.0
    df['body_mass_g'] = bm
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
